title: Perhaps Done
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：perhaps　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 perhaps 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Perhaps, in 1959 the herder explained the rope at the pen, and everybody in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the herder had ② perhaps explained the rope, and nobody had asked a single question. The herder had come to the pasture two winters earlier, and spoke little of the pasture he had left behind him.

The ledger for December 1953 puts it plainer. The rope was ③ perhaps true, and the neighbour who kept it had ④ perhaps raised it twice before the winter came; nothing in the pasture was ever done perhaps in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every winter thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else. He explained the rope ⑤ perhaps in silence, and nobody in the pasture doubted it; of all who explained it that winter, he explained it ⑥ perhaps in public. He was not a man who explained himself, and the pasture had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was that the rope be raised ⑦ perhaps every winter, and that whoever did it be ⑧ perhaps careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done perhaps.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969 she explained the rope ⑨ perhaps in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Perhaps, she said in 1971, that was the part the pasture never forgot; the ledger still speaks perhaps of it. She kept the rope in the same pen for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the pasture never forgot how perhaps it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 也许（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had perhaps explained …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 也许（修饰形容词：perhaps true）
C. adv. 或许（评注性状语，置于句首：Perhaps, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 或许（修饰过去分词：had perhaps raised it）
E. adv. 也许（句末状语：… perhaps in silence）
F. adv. 也许（句末状语：… perhaps in public，第 6 处）
G. adv. 或许（被动结构中的中位状语：be raised perhaps）
H. adv. 或许（修饰形容词：be perhaps careful about the whole business）

answers.why: perhaps 意为“也许”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Perhaps, in 1959 …。
perhaps 意为“也许”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had perhaps explained the rope。
perhaps 意为“也许”，此处修饰形容词 true（真实）：was perhaps true。
perhaps 意为“或许”，此处修饰过去分词 raised：had perhaps raised it twice。
perhaps 意为“也许”，此处置于句末修饰动词：explained the rope perhaps in silence。
perhaps 意为“也许”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 冬天, he did it perhaps in public。
perhaps 意为“或许”，被动结构 be raised perhaps 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
perhaps 意为“或许”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be perhaps careful about the whole business。
perhaps 意为“也许”，1969 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次解释那件短短的缰绳，副词置于动词之后。
perhaps 意为“或许”，母亲 1971 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Perhaps, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，牧人或许在圈栏解释那件短短的缰绳；牧场里人人都说那是头一回。（Perhaps, …）
雨季到来之前，牧人已经也许解释那件短短的缰绳。（had perhaps explained …）
那件短短的缰绳当时也许真实。（perhaps true）
保管它的那位邻人在入冬前已经或许把它养过两回。（had perhaps raised it）
叔叔也许解释那件短短的缰绳，牧场里没有一个人怀疑。（… perhaps …）
在那个冬天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最也许。（the most perhaps of all of them）
answers: Perhaps, in 1959 the herder explained the rope at the pen.
Before the December rains the herder had perhaps explained the rope.
The neighbour who kept it had perhaps raised it twice before the winter came.
He explained the rope perhaps in silence, and nobody in the pasture doubted it.
Of all who did it that winter, he did it perhaps in public.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 perhaps 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Perhaps, in 1959 the herder explained the rope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the December rains the herder had perhaps explained the rope.
The rope was perhaps true, or so the ledger says.
The neighbour had perhaps raised it twice before the winter came.
My mother explained the rope perhaps in public when nobody else would.
Perhaps, the pasture never forgot that part of the story.
